title: hypericum stragulum
intro: Hypericum stragulum, commonly known as the shrubby St. John's Wort, is a flowering plant species in the St. John's Wort family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce anxiety and depression by promoting relaxation and improving mood. The bioactive constituents of Hypericum stragulum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum stragulum also include its ability to act as an anti-anxiety and antidepressant agent, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy in humans.
